description:
Check whether a country or region carries sanctions designations
(OFAC's programs). `lists`: optional comma-separated list slugs; add `fatf`
(e.g. "ofac,fatf") to also check FATF's black and grey lists, which set
`flagged` but never `sanctioned`. `ref`: optional reference of your own, echoed and
recorded on the audit trail.
name: screen_country
title: Check country sanctions
